t: You're looking at the Stockwell Memorial Mural, a war memorial painted in London. It was made by Brian Barnes, a British artist who lived from 1944 to 2021. Barnes was appointed a Member of the Order of the British Empire in 2005 for services to the community in Battersea. That tells you he was a community figure as well as an artist. Look closely at the mural itself to see what it commemorates.
